sources.title: Academy screenwriting activities guide
sources.license: Reference only; original summary, no copied screenplay extracts
sources.note: Separate setting and visible action from character cues and spoken dialogue. Dramatic conflict connects character choices to events.

sources.title: Fountain syntax
sources.note: Distinguish scene headings, action, character cues, dialogue and parentheticals. For Bangla character names, explicit character markers avoid ambiguity.

lessons.instruction: Begin each scene with location/time and concise filmable action before any dialogue. Show who occupies the space, what they physically do and one meaningful environmental detail. Interleave later actions and reactions with dialogue; never place all action in one introductory paragraph. Internal emotions must have playable behavior, not explanatory narration.

Offer three different opening images; choose the one with the strongest character-linked unanswered question and record why. Establish a normal pattern, disrupt it concretely, make the protagonist act. The opening must promise the story actually delivered. Avoid generic dark nights, rhetorical narrator questions, arbitrary jump scares and withholding basic geography.

Plan objective, obstacle, tactic, turning point and consequence for each scene. A choice or discovery must cause the next scene. No convenient rescues or repeated information. Cut or combine scenes whose removal changes nothing. Track what each character knows and every prop's location.

Use natural contemporary Bangladeshi Bangla, relationship-specific আপনি/তুমি/তুই and distinct rhythms. Each line is a tactic (deflect, bargain, test, reassure, conceal); characters need not state their feelings. Avoid explaining visible actions or facts both speakers already know. Use silence, interruptions and small tasks. Keep parentheticals sparse and playable.

Build dread from a specific rule and evidence that contradicts it. Give a rational interpretation, then a costly test. Escalate consequence rather than volume. Plant a fair clue before its payoff. End on a changed situation or decision, not a random scream.

Give every family member a valid competing need. Express affection and authority through shared tasks and objects. Let embarrassment or conflicting habits generate warmth and humor; do not insert unrelated jokes. Let emotional revelations alter behavior before speeches.

Attraction grows through observed choices, reciprocal attention and earned vulnerability. Establish plausible access and contact; do not use repeated accidental meetings. Give both characters agency, boundaries and a life outside the romance.

Respect the requested cast, locations, duration and continuity. Estimate action and speech time separately without double-counting simultaneous actions. Music and SFX must name a dramatic purpose or visible/off-screen source; silence is allowed. Keep editorial commentary separate from the screenplay. Never claim structural validation proves artistic quality.

examples.weak: রহিম খুব ভয় পেল। রহিম: আমার খুব ভয় করছে।
examples.improved:
INT. রান্নাঘর — রাত
রহিম গ্যাসের চুলার নব বন্ধ করে। শিখা নিভে যায়। পাশের খালি চেয়ারের কাপ থেকে চামচ নাড়ার শব্দ আসে। সে নিজের কাপটা নামিয়ে রাখে।
রহিম: চিনি লাগবে?
চামচের শব্দ থামে।
examples.lesson: Fear becomes a physical test; ordinary hospitality conceals panic. Source of the sound is specific.
examples.rights: Original REDPAD teaching example; not a quotation

examples.weak: মা: আমি তোমার চাকরি নিয়ে চিন্তিত। ছেলে: আমিও চিন্তিত।
examples.improved:
INT. খাবার ঘর — সকাল
মা ছেলের শার্টের ছেঁড়া বোতাম সেলাই করে। ছেলে ফোনের চাকরির আবেদনটা বন্ধ করে বাজারের তালিকা খোলে।
ছেলে: আজ বাজারটা আমি করি?
মা সুতো কাটে। শার্টটা তার দিকে বাড়িয়ে দেয়।
মা: বাজার পালাবে না। বাসটা পালাবে।
examples.lesson: A practical task expresses care without announcing it; the mother changes the son's next action.
examples.rights: Original REDPAD teaching example; not a quotation

examples.weak: ছেলে: তুমি খুব ভালো মানুষ। মেয়ে: তুমিও।
examples.improved:
EXT. বাসস্টপ — বিকেল
তৃষা ছাতাটা বাড়িয়ে দেয়। নীল নেয় না; তার কাঁধের অর্ধেক বৃষ্টিতে ভিজছে। তৃষা ছাতার হাতলটা দুজনের মাঝখানে সরায়।
তৃষা: এত দূরে দাঁড়ালে ছাতার দোষ হবে।
নীল এক পা এগোয়। ছাতার নিচে রাখা তার কাগজের ব্যাগটা আগে শুকনো জায়গায় সরিয়ে দেয়।
examples.lesson: Attention and an invitation create warmth; action carries the attraction.
